The approved source manifest compiles deterministically into exactly six prohibited-acquisition dry-run records with the approved manifest identity.
Pinned dependencies, static analysis, schema drift, unit and property tests, branch coverage, and activation-specific CI pass.
No external source is fetched and no real archive volume is mutated.
The counted substantive change remains at or below the 1,200-line hard cap.
The final commit contains only this handoff pair and the PR remains draft.
